name: Tomáš Zdechovský, Dick Erixon - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the protection of the Union’s financial interests in the post-2027 multiannual financial framework through the revision of the anti-fraud architecture
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on how the EU should fight fraud against its budget from 2028. It asks the Commission to improve cooperation between the EU bodies that investigate fraud, to share information faster through a single entry point, to allow EU anti-fraud investigators to work alongside prosecutors under clear time limits, and to track recovered money better. It also wants annual joint meetings and a single yearly report. This is an opinion; no law changes yet.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to propose legal changes by end of 2026.
- **Who it affects:** EU fraud bodies, national authorities, and anyone reporting suspected fraud.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must report back on which requests it will act on.
